evidence.claim: Links HJT manufacturing plans to Starmind orbital AI. The reported 100 GW/year ambition is a scenario scale, not operational capacity.

First HJT line exceeds EUR 60 million, delivery H1 2027; more lines planned. Initial line throughput and cell efficiency are undisclosed. The release refers to more than 100 GW of equipment without an annual rate or completion date.
AI1 compute payload: 175 kW average, 250 kW peak; 30 m deployed height and 75 m wingspan; solar-powered compute with Starlink laser connectivity. Not measured flight telemetry.
Radiative heat balance includes internal dissipation and absorbed solar, albedo and planetary infrared energy.
Eclipse duration depends on altitude and beta angle; sun-synchronous alone does not ensure continuous sunlight.
